items.title: Absolute magnetic actuation force qualification F(x)
items.current_evidence: Previous FEMM work is field/concept screening only; it is not an absolute-force release qualification.
items.required_output: F_available(x) with nominal and worst-case envelopes over the functional stroke/critical positions.
closure_criteria: Freeze authoritative magnetic geometry against current engineering baseline.
Confirm B001/B002 magnet dimensions, grade and supplier magnetic properties including Br(T) or equivalent data.
Calculate absolute magnetic force F(x), not only field maps.
Sweep critical operating temperature / magnetic-property variation.
Derive mechanical required-force envelope from K01 mechanism/friction/load requirements.
Demonstrate minimum available-force / maximum required-force design margin.
Correlate calculated force against bench measurements at defined positions.
items.prohibited_release_claim: Do not mark magnetic release PASS from field screening alone.
